content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets through a sovereign digital commerce stack means bypassing traditional payment processors and their restrictive fees. When you opt for crypto payments, you eliminate the 10% fees often associated with platforms like Gumroad. Instead, NOWPayments charges only a 0.5% fee, allowing creators to keep more of their hard-earned revenue. This model not only enhances profitability but also provides creators with total ownership of their sales process without dependency on external platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture involves a combination of free tools working seamlessly together. At its core, you have hosting via GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and product delivery handled by Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and payment verification occurs in real time using NOWPayments. This streamlined infrastructure ensures that digital products are delivered instantly and securely after payment confirmation.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions facing financial isolation and restrictions from conventional payment platforms. Whether you’re selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software, this stack empowers you to operate independently. By choosing this architecture, you’re not just selling products; you’re establishing a sustainable business model that prioritizes your needs and allows you to thrive without the burdens imposed by traditional payment systems.
NOWPayments cuts your transaction fees to just 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component of the sovereign commerce stack plays a crucial role in creating a seamless experience for both the creator and the customer. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide reliable hosting for your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend processes efficiently. Supabase or Google Sheets manage order data, while NOWPayments facilitates low-fee crypto transactions. Together, they form a cohesive infrastructure that supports your digital commerce needs while ensuring you maintain total ownership.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, which provides all necessary blueprints and templates. Follow the documentation to set up your hosting environment with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Load your products into Supabase or Google Sheets and integrate NOWPayments for transaction processing. With these steps, you can have your online store operational in no time.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, use a sovereign digital commerce stack that employs free tools and crypto payment processing. This setup eliminates high platform fees and allows you complete ownership of your sales. NOWPayments offers a straightforward way to accept crypto payments at a fraction of the cost of traditional platforms, making it an ideal choice for digital creators.
You own every aspect of your digital commerce stack.

Explore related searches like selling ebooks without PayPal or Gumroad to discover how this architecture can transform your business.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
